steps.actual: FAIL at rollback.sh:112-115. Integrity gate, postgres-ready wait, dropdb+createdb (line 105-109) and docker cp all succeeded; pg_restore then failed: 'pg_restore: error: connection to server on socket /var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432 failed: FATAL: role "root" does not exist' -> script exit 2. DB left EMPTY (dropped, restore failed). Cause: compose exec lands as uid=0(root) (postgres:17-alpine sets no USER; verified docker exec id = uid=0). pg_restore in rollback.sh:114 lacks -U "$POSTGRES_USER", so it connects over the socket as OS user root, which has no role. Production impact: repo deploy/compose.yaml postgres service also sets no 'user:' -> identical failure expected on the real host, AFTER dropdb already destroyed the live DB (empty-DB window; data only recoverable from the backup file itself).
steps.root_cause_proof: diagnostic replay [diag2]: same chain dropdb+createdb then pg_restore --no-owner --no-privileges -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -j 4 -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -> exit 0, DB fully restored: enterprise=1, provider=1, head=0091_recorded_cost_accounting_policy. Sole delta = -U. DESTRUCTIVE semantics (post-backup row wiped) demonstrated by this successful restore.
steps.minimal_fix_suggestion: rollback.sh line 114: pg_restore --no-owner --no-privileges -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -j 4 -d "$TARGET_DB" /tmp/rollback-restore.dump (or run compose exec with --user). NOT applied in this drill: contract forbids modifying the two scripts (originals or copies under test).
steps.resolution: 发现 -U 缺陷 → 修复（rollback.sh:114 加 -U "$POSTGRES_USER"，注释补根因）→ ROUND 2 复演 PASS（见 round2.steps）。本条为历史记录，保留不抹。
